notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Hi SCP players!
We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

First of all, we have reached the amount of 500 SCPs available in the game!
We have also decided to add a new visual upgrade to SCP Strategy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/3b47803496cbe31b42e3dcc56a2bca32055c8306.png

SCPs added in v1.7 :

 SCP- 634 - Goldfish with memory-weakening effects
 SCP- 636 - Maintenance elevator with special access to a sub-basement
 SCP- 637 - Psychic organism residing in an elderly woman's brain, manifesting as a cat
 SCP- 639 - Caucasian male observed from all angles simultaneously, inducing paranoia and headaches in observers
 SCP- 640 - Sentient electromagnetic phenomenon manifesting as yellow-orange light spots
 SCP- 641 - Unusually thin Russian matryoshka dolls with anomalous properties
 SCP- 643 - Collection of chocolate candies with assimilative properties when melted
 SCP- 644 - Italian man known as "Mr. Hot," with the ability to detect if someone has children and comprehend children's wishes
 SCP- 645 - Marble disk with a humanoid face, similar to the Bocca della Verità carving
 SCP- 646 - Grey gelatinous creature that gives birth to non-anomalous species
 SCP- 647 - Cardboard box that morphs to fit anyone nearby and consumes them
 SCP- 649 - Matchbox with anomalous cold and snow-producing properties when opened or a match is struck
 SCP- 650 - Black mannequin that follows people when not observed, assumes threatening poses but is harmless
 SCP- 651 - Highly contagious virus causing fusion of human soft tissues
 SCP- 653 - Multi-colored plastic boomerang causing obsession and location awareness in those who touch it
 SCP- 654 - Male narwhal with a uniquely clockwise-grown tusk
 SCP- 655 - Windowless structure in the Democratic Republic of Congo that irregularly creates animal-like beings
 SCP- 657 - Elegantly-dressed man who can predict the exact date of a person's death
 SCP- 658 - Autonomous robotic devices with spider-like legs and a unique upper half in each specimen
 SCP- 660 - Irregular earthenware urn with an interior coated in mammalian uterine tissue

You can join our discord.

We also remind you about the upcoming beta tests of SCP: The Expedition! Will you join a new amazing adventure?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329910/SCP_The_Expedition/?utm_source=scps_steam

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.7
notes.notes:
Hi SCP players!

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

New SCPs!
We have added new 28 SCPs. SCP Strategy offers 250 SCP objects now!

Special Events!
Make important decisions that affect gameplay. Different decisions add different modifiers that change your statistics, relations and may bring unexpected consequences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/6306f8646353800ccc66319baa0c58a3f5edbbdc.jpg

( this panel will be displayed one more time after loading save with score above  5000 )

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.6
notes.notes:
Hi SCP players!

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png

Anomalies Market!

Now you can trade objects. Unlock proper skills and the Anomalies Market will be available in the Scientific Department.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/d28f40c850e4508e29ab300a7ffc67c07d821129.jpg

Redesigned Scientific Department!

Now Scientific Department will let you sell your objects. The details section has been a little bit redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/53b8a3709ec0b3eff6df4e29e8a85ec8d3ab7f29.jpg

Improved Battles!

Now you can inflict critical damage to your enemies.  That makes battles more unpredictable. Moreover, after a few battles, you can completely destroy hostile organizations. Now, relationships between organizations will now be better simulated. That means their power will be changed every month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a05e0d5565ad17cb8bee5040fdae1db167fa3a56.jpg

New Skills!

Unlock new skills to increase the chances of your spies, get access to the Anomalies Market and inflict critical hits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/865c8ea5bb91aa3f6047cd2911bfb3dbdee8beb0.jpg


v0.6 full changelog:

 redesigned Scientific Department
 added Anomalies Market
 added 22 new SCP objects
 added new skills
 added GOIs power's system ( now you can destroy every organization )
 added new buttons in the pause menu ( how to play, report bug )
 added new tutorials
 reorganize skills in Engineering Department
 improved battles system  ( critical hits )
 improved finding new anomalies  ( it will be easier to find objects added from mods )
 improved statistics system
 improved spying other organizations
 improved game save files
 improved optimization
 improved credits' screen
 changed chance to win after using  Commander +++ skill
 fixed relations system
 fixed loading icons in mods editor
 fixed some typos
 fixed generating names for new objects
 fixed showing short descriptions of objects when language was not set to English 


If you want to help us with the translation process visit localizor.com/scp-strategy.

Let us know if you will find any new bugs or issues. 
You can also join our discord.

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Hi SCP players!

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png

The new Intelligence Agency screen!

Now you can find there other groups of interest. You can spy on them and then attack to gain some profits. This panel will also show you what organizations could be dangerous and learn more about their combat abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/e2abde53b950178b448f8ab4245b991355029eac.png

Organizations edtor!

Now you can create and share also new organizations. The new editor will let you the ability to create dreamed-up opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a4e81ae6d2f34f140b172027efa7ccd1c99add5a.jpg

Redesigned Internal Department!

Now Internal Department will let you manage all of your sites and MTFs easier in one place!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/1878877af821bed786698db65a00a16bfd9739da.png

Toggling borders!

Click the globe's icon on the top right corner to enable or disable borders. You can switch between three modes. The first one will show only coastlines,  the second one will show you countries' borders, and the last one will show you provinces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/57ca64c427d0780dd253f559a7fe5fcc80b36896.jpg


v0.4 full changelog:

 redesigned Internal Department's screen ( now it contains sites' and mtfs' view)
 redesigned Intelligence Agency's screen ( now it shows other groups of interest )
 added spying and attacking other organizations
 added organizations' editor to the modding tools ( Steam Workshop is supported! )
 added toggling borders on the globe
 added separate volume settings for combat sounds
 balanced battles ( the player will be attacked less often after losses)
 fixed sounds and music on the main menu
 fixed showing unadded languages in the settings panel
 improved save files ( the first run of v0.4 may reset your volume settings! )
 improved optimization



Let us know if you will find any new bugs or issues. 
You can also join our discord.
